<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex67022024-09-1610-30-07" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon in instance (ID:4711)"/>
				'di ni <lb edRef="inst:4711" n="122a5"/> bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i <expan>blo gros</expan> kyis sde snod du ma'i don thugs su chud cing yon tan du ma'i dpal 'byor gyis 'gro ba mang po'i 'dren pa chen por gyur pa | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhan po nam <lb edRef="inst:4711" n="122a6"/> mkha' <expan>ye shes</expan></rs> dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">mkhan po zhang chos rgyal rin chen</rs> dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">mkhan po byams pa'i dpal</rs> <expan>la sogs</expan> pa slob ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4068">shAkya'i dge slong skad gnyis <lb edRef="inst:4711" n="122a7"/> smra ba <expan>blo gros</expan> dpal bzang po</rs>s gtso bo che par <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">mkhas pa chen po shes rab 'byung gnas <expan>blo gros</expan></rs> gyi 'grel pa dang <expan>bstun nas</expan> gsal bar bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5802">dge slong ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge</rs>'o ||</seg></TEI>
